verdict.rationale: Netlify documents that every PR automatically gets its own preview URL (Deploy Previews), and that environments can be shared with collaborators. A community user corroborates PR preview builds. This gives each team member's change a separate deployed environment to work in parallel. However, the evidence never states these environments are unlimited, and it never describes isolation beyond the frontend deploy, such as per-preview backends, data, or env vars. missing for 10: explicit documentation that preview environments are unlimited, evidence of full isolation (per-environment backend/data/secrets), independent confirmation of many simultaneous team environments at scale

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously
